電子レンジはなぜ食べ物を温められる？――電磁波が熱に変わるまで

A Japanese-English mixed explanation of microwave heating. It moves beyond the familiar 'water molecules vibrate' story and explains dielectric heating through polar molecules, ions, penetration depth, heat conduction, standing waves, and the different dielectric behavior of ice and liquid water.
